description: Speed surface hidden when the vehicle-condition (doors) overlay is active: gear=P(1) and LF door open(2) drive DI_AEC_VehicleCondition_Show to RET_SHOW, which sets sta_vehicleConditionShow=1; diSpeedSurface Draw() returns immediately when vehicleConditionShow==1, so SPEED is not rendered.

can.desc: Speed_Signal_151_S: 0 km/h while parked, gear P
Shift_Mode_26F_S: val_gear=1 (P) -> vehicle-condition doors logic active
DOORS_294 LF door status 2 (open) -> sta_lfDoorShow=RET_SHOW (diAEControl.cpp DI_AEC_VehicleCondition_Show)
